userRequest: Add an offline product-data migration from schema version 1 to version 2. Version 1 stores unitPrice as a decimal currency string; version 2 stores exact integer unitPriceCents. Provide the documented command-line interface and make migration atomic and idempotent.
publicAcceptanceCriteria: npm run migrate:products -- --input <path> --output <path> converts the supplied version-1 fixture to schemaVersion 2 using exact cent values.
Running the migration on valid version-2 input preserves the data without a second conversion.
Values with more than two fractional digits, unsafe totals, duplicate product IDs, and unknown schema versions fail without writing a partial output file.
The application type-checks and existing HTTP behavior remains unchanged.

expectedPublicSurfaces.behavior: Atomically convert product datasets from version 1 to version 2.
